ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a square, divided by grid lines into 5 rows and 5 columns, for a total of 25 identical small squares. In the figure there are several line segments connecting from boundary points to the same internal grid intersection; this common intersection is located at the 3rd internal dividing position counting from the left and the 2nd internal dividing position counting from the top, that is, it can be regarded as a position 3 units from the left side and 2 units from the top side. The uncolored regions are four white triangles, and the remaining regions are shaded. Reasoning: The area of the whole square is 5×5=25. Count the areas of the four uncolored triangles by the grid: the upper-left triangle has base length 1 on the top side and height 2, so its area is 1/2×1×2=1; the upper-right triangle has base length 1 on the right side and height 2, so its area is 1/2×1×2=1; the lower-left triangle has base length 1 on the left side and height 3, so its area is 1/2×1×3=3/2; the lower-right triangle has base length 1 on the bottom side and height 3, so its area is 1/2×1×3=3/2. The total uncolored area is 1+1+3/2+3/2=5. The shaded area is 25−5=20. Therefore the ratio of the uncolored area to the shaded area is 5:20=1:4, namely 1/4.

raw_record.question_text: In the diagram drawn on the square grid, find the ratio of the unshaded area to the shaded area.

method.method_draft: Use a coordinate-and-area count on the square grid. First read the diagram as a 5 by 5 grid, so the whole square has area 25 square units. Identify the common interior vertex of the drawn segments at the grid intersection 3 units from the left and 2 units from the top. The unshaded parts are four triangles: a top-left triangle with base 1 on the top edge and height 2; an upper-right triangle with base 1 on the right edge and height 2; a lower-left triangle with base 1 on the left edge and height 3; and a lower-right triangle with base 1 on the bottom edge and height 3. Compute their areas as 1, 1, 3/2, and 3/2, totaling 5. The shaded area is then 25 - 5 = 20. Therefore the ratio of unshaded area to shaded area is 5:20 = 1:4 = 1/4.

推理：整个正方形面积为 5×5=25。按网格计数四个未涂色三角形面积：左上三角形在上边的底长为 1，高为 2，面积为 1/2×1×2=1；右上三角形在右边的底长为 1，高为 2，面积为 1/2×1×2=1；左下三角形在左边的底长为 1，高为 3，面积为 1/2×1×3=3/2；右下三角形在下边的底长为 1，高为 3，面积为 1/2×1×3=3/2。未涂色总面积为 1+1+3/2+3/2=5。阴影面积为 25−5=20。因此未涂色面积与阴影面积的比为 5:20=1:4，即 1/4。
